@Jeffrey
I’d just about cut a leg off to work with the technology stack you chose. Alas, I’m dragging a family with me everywhere I go and taking a contract position (especially on a relocation) is impossible.
It’s a shame. I’d work for caffine and food if my fulltime job is working with ASP.NET MVC.
I did a presentation here in Lubbock Tuesday on ASP.NET MVC. It should have lasted an 1 1/2 hour but people stayed for an extra hour asking questions. Pretty exciting stuff.
